column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the stronghold” is rendered “The high stronghold,” and “shattered” “dismayed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O Madmen, you will be silent” is rendered “You also shall be cut down, O Madmen!”
NKJV renders the word glossed “its servants” as “Her little ones,” following the Qere; the meaning is uncertain.
NKJV renders “the distresses of the cry of destruction people will hear” as “the enemies have heard a cry of destruction,” taking the word as “enemies.”
NKJV renders “give salt to Moab” as “Give wings to Moab”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “with slackness” is rendered “deceitfully.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who tip” is rendered “wine-workers,” and “jars” “bottles.”
Close to the Hebrew; the difficult “its cities he has gone up” is rendered “gone up from her cities”; the meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “Jahaz” is spelled “Jahzah.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Moab will splash in its vomit” is rendered “Moab shall wallow in his vomit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you shook yourself” is rendered “You shake your head in scorn.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mouth of a ravine” is rendered “the cave’s mouth.”
NKJV renders “his arrogance” as “his wrath” (the Hebrew word can mean either) and “his empty boasts” as “His lies.”
